analysis: Reviewed BASE ProviderLoop.swift lines 1-1192 and the complete patch, which changes only head lines 719-730 and 882. The patch adds state declarations: selectedModelRecovery (SelectedModelRecovery), a test-only selectedModelRecoveryLoadOverride hook that is nil in production, savedEnabledModels seeded from config.config.backend.enabledModels at init, and enabledModelsAtLastSwitch. These are stored-property additions with no logic in this file. They do not touch keyPair/NodeKeyPair (A-003), attestation signer creation (A-002, A-010), modelHashes/liveModelHashes (T-012, T-027), the encryption/send paths (T-008), App Attest state (TB-011, T-052, T-053), the add-on hold (TB-012, T-059) or the prefix-cache plumbing (T-041). The override seam follows the existing test-seam pattern, for example startupPreloadLoadOverride at base line 761. No regression is visible in this file. Integration questions: ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery.swift is not supplied. It needs checking for four things: (1) recovery loads go through the advertised-set, self-test and failedSelfTestHashes/retiringModels tombstone gates (base lines 417-430), so a retired or failed build is not reloaded and served without re-passing its self-test or weight-hash capture; (2) recovery respects the admission gates (isShuttingDown, updatePhase draining, lifecycle drain, add-on holds per T-059 and A-018); (3) the 'no-eviction' load does not bypass the memory/KV budget; (4) selectedModelRecoveryLoadOverride cannot be set outside tests. savedEnabledModels is read from operator config by the policy refresh. Its use in status or switch should not change the running selection or advertisement without the committed-switch validation path, and that path is not visible here.
